result.instructions: Ostadix-lang / O-lang MCP (Rust). Supply one complete .O document as o_execute.source for the ordinary computational workflow; optional bindings are ordinary JSON and optional constraints are resource ceilings. Ostadix performs parsing, OIR lowering, planning, HGraph analysis, admission, and execution internally and returns one typed result with evidence. Use o_execute for complete ordinary or lifted .O source; lifted projects carry their own inputs and default route. Use o_run for existing paths, explicit project routes, or explicit whole-document hosted placement. Use o_env/o_runtimes/o_doctor when diagnostics are needed. Set o_run.placement=node only to submit the complete document to one selected hosted node; this is not graph splitting or project mesh. Use o_analyze_intent then o_execute_intent only for an explicit review-then-execute workflow with a one-use same-intent gate. Use o_information_inspect only for bounded descriptive reads of an existing local Information V1 head; it grants no authority. Never pass the literal string O_BACKENDS_DIR; never put $VAR inside .O sources (O splices $IDENT).

tools.name: o_information_inspect
tools.description: Inspect exactly one existing local Information V1 head through the fixed read-only o-info path; no cloud, network, mutation, dispatch, or arbitrary subcommands

state.description: Existing local Information V1 state directory (absolute or relative to O_LANG_ROOT; maximum 4096 UTF-8 bytes)

head.description: Fixed local head name (default main; maximum 128 ASCII token bytes)

tools.name: o_doctor
tools.description: Toolchain doctor: check O, olangc, backends, shims, all backend runtimes, and optional a18re search/o-run

tools.name: o_execute_intent
tools.description: Consume a one-use o_analyze_intent handle and ask O to recompute the same stable Intent V1 before fresh V6 admission and dispatch

handle.description: Opaque one-use handle returned by o_analyze_intent

path.description: Path resolving to the same canonical .O program analyzed earlier

cwd.description: Working directory resolving to the same canonical cwd analyzed earlier

tools.name: o_olangc
tools.description: Run olangc on a .O file, or materialize an exact binary/WASM Cargo project without invoking Cargo

path.description: Path to a .O program (relative paths use O_LANG_ROOT)

target.description: olangc target: binary | ir | dot | script | wasm; omitted target defaults to binary

output.description: Optional -o output path (relative paths use O_LANG_ROOT)

materialize_only.description: Materialize the exact binary/WASM Cargo project into a new directory beneath the MCP server cwd without invoking Cargo

tools.name: o_search_run
tools.description: Run a bundled O work program or an explicitly selected a18re search program with correct absolute backends

name.description: Leaf O program name, with optional .O suffix; bundled names resolve under examples/, external work names under search/

work.description: Optional a18re/work root; default A18_WORK, existing ~/a18re, or the bundled O_LANG_ROOT

tools.name: o_execute
tools.description: Execute one complete .O source document, including a lifted project, with optional bindings and constraints. Ostadix selects its ordinary or project execution path and returns the actual result and execution evidence. Bindings apply to ordinary programs; lifted projects carry their own inputs.

bindings.description: Optional typed input bindings expressed as ordinary JSON values

constraints.description: Optional execution deadline and lower resource ceilings

max_source_bytes.description: Optional lower source-size ceiling in bytes (server maximum 65536)

max_binding_bytes.description: Optional lower canonical binding-size ceiling in bytes (server maximum 1048576)

tools.name: o_runtimes
tools.description: Discover executable requirements for every canonical Ostadix backend without blocking on missing optional runtimes

tools.name: o_env
tools.description: Report O-lang / Ostadix-lang environment: roots, tools, shim presence, and all-runtime summary

tools.name: o_smoke
tools.description: Smoke-test O toolchain: run examples/hello.O (expect 2) with correct backends path

tools.name: o_run
tools.description: Execute one complete .O source document or existing path through Ostadix's unified, project-aware front door and return its structured result

path.description: Existing .O program or project path. Supply exactly one of path or source

source.description: Complete .O source document. Supply exactly one of source or path

cwd.description: Optional working directory (relative paths use O_LANG_ROOT)

placement.description: Execution placement: local (default unified front door) or node (complete document on one selected hosted node)

node_id.description: Optional discovered node identity for placement=node; omitted uses the remembered or deterministic node selection

route.description: Optional project route ID when a project or lifted bundle has no unambiguous default

tools.name: o_analyze_intent
tools.description: Analyze a .O program without executing it and issue a bounded, expiring, one-use same-intent handle (not authorization or a capability)

path.description: Path to a .O program (absolute paths default cwd to their parent; relative paths use cwd/O_LANG_ROOT)

cwd.description: Optional working directory (relative paths use O_LANG_ROOT)

ttl_secs.description: One-use handle lifetime in seconds (default 120; maximum 900)
